mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, reducing budesonide metabolism and increasing systemic corticosteroid exposure with risk of HPA axis suppression and adverse effects.
action: Monitor for signs of corticosteroid excess; consider alternative antibiotic (e.g., amoxicillin) or reduce budesonide dose if clarithromycin is necessary; monitor cortisol levels if prolonged use anticipated.
